description_en: Upgrades the CDC node version of a PolarDB-X instance

kebab_example: aliyun polardbx upgrade-cdc-version --db-instance-name pxc-hzrp00003p72fi --cdc-minor-version polarx-cdc-kernel-5.4.19-20240928_17274884 --cdc-db-version 2.343 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-name pxc-shrvdc0000wtf5uk-cdc --switch-mode 0 --region cn-hangzhou
